designationHistory.indexText: Catahoula National Wildlife Refuge was established under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act as a wintering area for waterfowl.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Catahoula National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
